name: web-dark-team-section-with-circular-portraits-and-two-tone-heading
title: Dark 'OUR CREATIVE TEAM' heading in white and grey with a paragraph, social icons and three circular portraits with names and roles
whatItIs: A black page with a small 'OUR' above a big grey condensed 'CREATIVE TEAM', a grey paragraph, a row of social icons and a URL, a top-right name and light Register button, and three round portraits (a woman, a man in a beanie, a bearded man) with white caps names and grey roles.
whatItMeans: Minimal and confident; circular portraits and a two-tone heading keep a team section calm.
techniques: Show social icons in a row.

vocabulary.definition: A heading in white and grey parts.
A photo cropped to a circle.
A small line naming a job title.
A line of small platform icons.
